name: initscript-swap
description: Add a swap file so a Node with less than 1 GiB of memory survives package installs next to running services (for example the telemetry agent). Env: SWAP_MB (default 1024). Its step runs before the request's own scripts

scripts.name: swap
scripts.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Adds a swap file unless swap is already on, so a small Node survives package installs next to running services.
# SWAP_MB sets the size (default 1024). Put this step before the ones that install packages.
set -e
SIZE="${SWAP_MB:-1024}"
FILE=/swapfile
if [ "$(swapon --noheadings --show | wc -l)" -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "swap already enabled"; exit 0
fi
AVAIL=$(df -Pm / | awk 'NR==2 {print $4}')
if [ "$AVAIL" -lt $((SIZE + 1024)) ]; then
  echo "skipped: ${AVAIL} MiB free on /, need ${SIZE} MiB plus 1024 MiB spare"; exit 0
fi
# dd rather than fallocate: some filesystems refuse swap on preallocated extents
dd if=/dev/zero of="$FILE" bs=1M count="$SIZE" status=none
chmod 600 "$FILE"
mkswap "$FILE" >/dev/null
swapon "$FILE"
grep -q "^$FILE " /etc/fstab || echo "$FILE none swap sw 0 0" >> /etc/fstab
echo "swap enabled: ${SIZE} MiB"
